summary: iter336 RefKicker review-side reference continuity tested across all 7 detail surfaces. 6/7 surfaces correctly mount RefKicker ABOVE the H1 with the unified 'Ref · <ID>' visual contract (view-incident-ref, view-daily-ref, view-inspection-ref, view-meeting-ref, view-equip-inspection-ref, hr-dr-detail-ref). ViewSafetyForm renders the kicker BELOW the H1 (positional regression vs spec). Submit-side ↔ review-side symmetry confirmed (thank-you-reference + view-incident-ref both render identical pattern). ES translation 'Ref. · <ID>' confirmed. Legacy 'Form Ref:' line successfully removed from ViewSafetyForm. No forbidden new routes (/lookup, /track, /reference, /claim, /proof) added to App.js.

ui_bugs.issue: RefKicker is mounted AFTER the H1 (DOM/visual order: refTop=462 > h1Top=386). Spec says 'placed above the H1' and the other 6 surfaces (Incident/Daily/Inspection/Meeting/EquipmentInspection/HrDailyReportDetail) all correctly render RefKicker BEFORE the H1. SafetyForm is the only surface inverted.

ui_bugs.component: RefKicker on mobile 390px for legacy UUID-fallback records
ui_bugs.issue: On a 390px viewport, the 36-char UUID falls back wraps to 2 lines mid-ID at a hyphen (e.g., 'REF · 6CEBA301-93DC-4DD0-A6CC-' on line 1, 'B7EF8F61F12B' on line 2). Spec required 'no wrapping mid-ID'. Records with canonical short numbers (e.g., INC-2026-0517-002) are unaffected. Consider adding whitespace-nowrap + overflow handling on the ID span, or break-all only at the trailing UUID segment.

issues: Page-level horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=618 vs clientWidth=390. Not caused by RefKicker itself (refRight=374 fits) but by other wide content in the incident detail (likely the DOC ID label or wide tables). Not strictly an iter336 regression, but worth flagging since spec asked for scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 on detail pages.

action_items: Move <RefKicker> ABOVE the <h1> in ViewSafetyForm.jsx (lines 156-168) so it mirrors the other 6 detail surfaces and the spec ('placed above the H1').
Consider whitespace handling on the long-UUID fallback case so mobile 390 viewport doesn't wrap mid-ID.
Investigate residual horizontal overflow on /incidents/{id} at 390px (not iter336 scope but flagged by the spec request).
critical_code_review_comments: RefKicker.jsx is a clean reusable 30-line component with proper graceful absence (returns null when recordId falsy). Consistent visual contract across surfaces. Recommend adding a passthrough `aria-label` for screen readers (e.g., 'Reference number {recordId}') since the visual treatment is intentionally muted.

Positional inconsistency in ViewSafetyForm.jsx (RefKicker after H1) violates the documented design contract; the inline comment at line 161-163 even says 'replaces the legacy Form Ref: … line with the unified RefKicker used across all detail/review surfaces' — but the placement is not unified.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (6/7 surfaces fully spec-compliant; SafetyForm position regression)
